items.exampleEn: The weather is nice in October.
I have piano class on Thursday.
The library is closed on Tuesday.
Wednesday is the middle of the week.

items.sentenceEn: The shop closes at 9 p.m. on Sunday.
items.sentenceZh: 這家店星期天晚上九點關門。

items.audioEn: My piano class is on Tuesday and Thursday.
items.audioZh: 我的鋼琴課在星期二和星期四。

items.sentenceEn: I work from Monday to Wednesday.
items.sentenceZh: 我星期一到星期三上班。

items.sentenceEn: We visit my grandparents every Saturday.
items.sentenceZh: 我們每個星期六去看祖父母。

items.stemZh: 星期六的後一天是星期天。

items.stemEn: My birthday is in ____, the month after August.
items.stemZh: 我的生日在九月，就是八月的下一個月。

items.passageEn: Mia has a busy week. On Tuesday and Thursday, she has English class at 7 p.m. On Wednesday, she plays tennis. On Saturday, she works at a cafe. On Sunday, she is free. In October, she will go to Japan for a week.
items.passageZh: Mia 這週很忙。星期二和星期四晚上七點，她有英文課。星期三她打網球，星期六在咖啡店打工。星期天她有空。十月時，她會去日本一個星期。

items.promptZh: 我們星期六晚上七點見。
referenceEn: See you at 7 p.m. on Saturday.
Let's meet at seven on Saturday night.
rubricZh: 星期前用 on，時間點前用 at（例如 at 7 p.m. on Saturday）
「晚上七點」可寫 7 p.m.、seven in the evening、seven at night 等

referenceEn: We will move to a new house in October.
We are going to move to a new house in October.
rubricZh: 月份前用 in（例如 in October）
未來可寫，例如 will、be going to 等
